svg.title: Mind Map Studio: looks, languages and accessibility
svg.desc: A looping animation in four scenes. 1: the same map in the built-in presets Default, Dark, Corporate, Hand-drawn and Colour-blind safe, each with its own colours, shapes, lines and typeface. 2: in the preset editor a light text colour brings up the warning Some text may be hard to read (aim for 4.5:1 or more), a dark one clears it, and the lines switch from steps to curves. 3: Switch the interface to 简体中文 changes the toolbar to 导图, 头脑风暴, 大纲 and 分屏, the details panel to 详情, and the guide button to 入门指南. 4: a screen reader hears Added Pricing under Launch Plan, keyboard focus is outlined, and on a tablet tapping a node shows the action bar Child, Sibling, Rename, Notes, Delete, Fold and More.

g.text: One map, five built-in looks: colours, shapes, lines and typeface.
Some text may be hard to read (aim for 4.5:1 or more):
